summary_en: Business Brain will not tender its entire ~40% stake in GSX (code 4417) to Accenture's tender offer at 8,500 yen per share, but will instead sell all shares to GSX itself at 5,835 yen per share following GSX's self-acquisition. The transaction is expected to generate 17,054 million yen in equity method investment gains in the fiscal year ending March 2027.
title_en: Notice Regarding Execution of Agreement on Tender Offer for Equity Method Affiliate (Global Security Expert Inc.)
translation_en_brief:
On October 30, 2026, Business Brain Showa-Ota announced it will not participate in Accenture's tender offer for Global Security Expert Inc. (GSX, code 4417) at 8,500 yen per share. Instead, following the completion of Accenture's tender offer and squeeze-out procedures, Business Brain will sell its entire stake—approximately 40% of GSX—to GSX itself through GSX's self-acquisition program at 5,835 yen per share.

Business Brain has held its GSX stake through a series of partial dispositions since GSX's listing, viewing GSX's operational independence as beneficial to the affiliate's value and the group's overall value. The company determined that selling via GSX's self-acquisition, rather than tendering to Accenture, would better serve medium-to-long-term shareholder value. The self-acquisition price was structured such that Business Brain's after-tax proceeds, accounting for favorable deemed-dividend tax treatment under Japanese corporate tax law, would equal what the company would receive if it tendered at the public offer price.

The transaction is expected to generate an investment gain of 17,054 million yen upon recognition in the fiscal year ending March 31, 2027. GSX will transition from a consolidated equity-method affiliate to a non-affiliated company. The company has not revised earnings guidance as completion timing remains uncertain, but will update forecasts once visibility improves.
